scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection predominantely consists of Hudson Hills Press art books and publications, as well as a selection of chronological correspondence, royalties files, publishing and production files, declinations, and documentation of associated publicity.

Categories of published art books include but are not limited to: contemporary and modern artists; European, early American and 20th century art; Native American and southwestern art; furniture and decorative arts; museum collections; monographs; photography; and sculpture. HHP also publishes and distributes a variety of rare and limited edition titles.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Hudson Hills Press was a publisher and distributor of high quality illustrated books with a focus on fine art, decorative arts, works on paper and photography.
Hudson Hills Press was founded under the patronage of Nelson A. Rockefeller.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Arranged in series by record type.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Hudson Hills Press retains all copyright and literary rights to published works. The Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Hudson Hills Press donated the collection to the Rockefeller Archive Center in December 2001. The records were received by RAC in several accessions from 2001-2006.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
